coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday, resting in bed with the air conditioner on low
Washing up, brushing teeth, and taking a warm morning shower
Making and eating a relaxed breakfast, toasting bread and brewing tea with the kettle
Doing a stretching and light mobility routine on the floor
Sorting laundry and running a load of washing in the washing machine
Moving the wet laundry into the clothes dryer and folding the dry items
Vacuuming the living room floor and tidying the space
Cooking and eating a simple lunch, using the induction cooker and washing up afterwards
Going for a walk around the neighbourhood and picking up groceries on the public holiday (on foot, no electric vehicle used)
Watching TV and streaming shows while resting on the sofa
Using the computer to read physiotherapy journals and review professional notes with the desk lamp on
Taking an afternoon walk in the local park for fresh air and exercise (on foot, no electric vehicle used)
Preparing and cooking dinner from scratch at the stove, with the range hood running
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and wiping down the counters
Relaxing with TV and streaming, occasionally scrolling on the phone
Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
Reading in bed under the lamp and winding down for the night
Sleeping with the air conditioner set for the night
